.]] The Harmonic Mallet was created by the pandaren ten thousand years ago as a counter to the Divine Bell created by the mogu. When they struck the bell with the mallet, the monks were able to create pure harmony. Sometime after that, it was stolen by the Monkey King as a "prank". Fearful of what would happen if the mogu stole the mallet after already having stolen back the Divine Bell, the Monkey King split the mallet and scattered the two pieces across Pandaria to keep them from falling into mogu hands. Harvesting typically refers to gathering herbs via herbalism, but can generally mean to loot raw ingredient items from a resource node by right-clicking the resource and getting the raw items it produces after a time trying to harvest. A character usually needs to have learned a gathering profession to harvest.

The Harvest Festival is an annual world event that takes place in September or October, lasting for one week. During the Harvest Festival of Azeroth, the Horde and the Alliance give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf. In the time of the Harvest Festival, a great buffet is built up outside of Ironforge and Orgrimmar. From [http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/info/events/harvestfestival/ Harvest Festival] on the official site: :Throughout history, many have given their lives to aid their allies. Every year, members of the Horde and the Alliance set aside time to honor the memories of the fallen and to pay tribute to those whose me

Hasic is one of the eastern ports on the shores of Lordaeron. It is affiliated with the Alliance, and serves the Great Sea, offering passage by ship to Khaz Modan. Hasic maintained land routes to its neighbors, especially the major realms of Hillsbrad and Southshore. It is more than a week's journey to reach either one. The port's tavern was called the Sea Boar. Following the Second War and the Invasion of Draenor, Rhonin visited the northern area of the port seeking out boats to travel to Khaz Modan. When Rhonin and his escort arrived, Falstad Wildhammer and his gryphon riders were guarding Hasic, following an attack by a pair of dragon riders of the Dragonmaw clan three days earlier.
